Board meeting notes - CFO financial update (V. Wang presenting)

Q3 net loss was $6.8M against a $1.9M plan. Occupancy is at 71%, with churn in Westbrook and Dunmore. Leverage under the Senior Facility (s.7.2) was 3.1x against a 2.75x maximum as of the 9/30 test date, and interest coverage was 1.6x against a 2.0x minimum. The senior breach triggers the cross-default provision in the Meridian mezzanine agreement unless waived. Waiver request to senior lenders is due Dec 1; if denied, acceleration is possible in Q1 2027, and the downside case models default at 60% probability. Runway is about 5 months at current burn.

Board asked counsel to review default remedies. Restructuring options to come back at next meeting.
